# CloudCode — Universal Cloud Development Environment (CDE)

> CloudCode is a mobile-first Cloud Development Environment (CDE) platform that brings isolated Linux containers, real-time terminals, AI coding agents, and seamless Git workflows to mobile devices and web browsers.

## Key Capabilities
- **Mobile-First Cloud IDE:** A complete software engineering environment designed specifically for smartphones, tablets, and web browsers.
- **Isolated Linux Containers:** Instant Docker container provisioning in under 5 seconds with full terminal root access, package managers (npm, pip, apt), and runtime compilers.
- **Autonomous AI Companion:** Integrated AI agent for code generation, bug fixing, automated refactoring, and project-wide context awareness.
- **Git Version Control & PR Management:** Full Git support with SSH key authorization, branch management, visual diffing, and mobile Pull Request reviews.
- **Dynamic Web Previews:** Secure HTTPS & WebSocket preview proxies mapping internal container ports (e.g. 3000, 5173) for instant live testing.
